TZA.note: Only says Bank of Tanzania regulates the financial sector; TCRA licences operators, a telecoms regulator.
No consumer protection rules or complaints stated.
No government payments to people stated.
Gives mobile money account counts, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: TCRA's December 2025 sector status report, as reported by Daily News, shows 76,466,691 mobile money accounts and 6.3 billion transactions, with M-Pesa, Airtel, Mixx, Halopesa, Azam Pesa and T-Pesa operating.

TZA.note: No tax or fee payment stated.
